description:
Ranked allocation plan: intent + balances + regime + yields + ML signals (free read).

One call composes the read-only surfaces an agent would otherwise
orchestrate by hand -- lending supply APYs, LST staking yields, the
per-asset market regime, and the ML ensemble signal -- into a ranked,
intent-shaped plan (conservative | balanced | aggressive). Each
directional entry names the exact backtest_strategy args to validate
it BEFORE deploying, plus the follow-up tool that would act on it.
Descriptive analytics only -- never advice, never a promise of
results; nothing is executed.

Workflow: INTELLIGENCE/ANALYSIS step -- call after get_market_briefing
and before backtest_strategy / get_risk_assessment / strategy_*_create.
name: propose_allocation
